marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind light increasing to southeast 20 knots near noon
Thursday. Scattered showers this evening. Fog patches forming late
overnight and dissipating Thursday morning. Fog patches reforming Thursday
evening. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Over open water seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 early
Thursday evening.<br/>
